principles.text: Keep unlocked Voyager Teams active and re-dispatch promptly to avoid lost voyage throughput.
Use Compasses around reachable milestone breakpoints or to protect the final collection window rather than spending them randomly.
Delay opening lower-tier treasures until you know whether merging better fits your account bottleneck and final event position.
Complete final treasure merges before the collection window ends so auto-open does not remove the choice.

guidance: The source recommends Team 2 if the Gem cost fits the account.
Target reachable early milestones before considering higher voyage counts.
Merge selectively based on account needs rather than treating merging as universally mandatory.
Add a team or Compass bundle only when it creates a clear milestone jump.
The source rates Team 4 Backpack highly, but its value depends on remaining event time and account priorities.
Compare the 200/350-voyage targets with other gear-progression spending windows before pushing.
Do not treat headline rewards as equal if they do not address the account's current bottleneck.

morning: Check distance to the next milestone.
midday: Only spend Compasses when the timing creates concrete event value.
beforeBed: On the final active day, clear reachable voyages before dispatch closes.
